craft_notes: Sthāyin: mudrā-vīra of sealing — girt-am → nectar-life → eightfold-circle → seals-all → loosed-called → draught-dwells → moment-rises → effortless-all; the treatise seals effortless. Nectar-streak alone; life-shine-hearts. Rejected: (a) alone→only → killed: alone is solitary. Read aloud: IN-you a-LONE … SHINE in-OUR-hearts.

lines: In You alone — nectar-streak, supreme-power-made, last knower —
hence Lord — You alone worlds' life — shine in our hearts.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tvayy evāmṛtalekhā paraśaktimayī parapramātātaḥ nātha tvam eva jagatām jīvanam iti bhāsi no hṛdaye

reads_against.argmap: What life shines in heart? → Nectar-knower life shining in-heart.
c1_essence: Sealed all delighted throng by fullness-shown.
Conquering draught dwells clearly; stain known.
In-me flashing sealed; rite complete effortless.
reads_against.c1_rasa: raudra-vīra of ghoul-girt am-I; amṛta-bhakti of heart-shining; adbhuta of eightfold retinue; mudrā-vīra of sealed all; mudrā-vīra of called seal; vīra of conquering draught; adbhuta of momently rising; śānta of sealed rite
